title: RBI Issues Amendment Directions on Interest Rate on Deposits (Second Amendment Directions, 2026)
description: <cite index="51-1,51-2">On July 30, 2026, RBI issued Amendment Directions on interest rates on deposits for six types of banks including commercial banks, small finance banks, regional rural banks, and urban co-operative banks. RBI changed rules on how banks decide and display interest rates on deposits to make things more transparent and fair for customers.</cite>
